ESSENTIAL (MODIFICATIONS OF IMMIGRATION LAWS) REGULATIONS, 1969

In exercise of the powers conferred under section 2 of the Emergency
(Essential Powers) Ordinance No. 1, 1969, the Director of Operations
designated under section 2 of the Emergency (Essential Powers) Ordin-
ance No. 2, 1969, hereby makes the following regulations:
